parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records resides at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a canonical sample-application path. Even though `is_sample_app` is recorded as `false`, the file path is the authoritative signal per the decision rules. The duplicate `DebugMetricsProvider.handleDisplayLinkTick` in the sample app is almost certainly a local copy introduced to make the demo self-contained without taking a hard dependency on the `DebugPanel` package. Extracting the shared implementation into a common location would couple production `DebugPanel` code to sample-app semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against.
